F1.title_zh: 柔顺工具与保护性装配
F1.intro_zh: 借助锤头或保护垫的接触柔顺性，把紧配合零件装到位，并在撤手后保持稳定。任务从单点敲合扩展到软垫选择、错位恢复和双机框架装配；橡胶与刚体锤构成配对配置。
F1.intro_en: Seat tight-fitting parts using compliant tool contacts or protective pads, then release them stably. The tasks progress from single joints to pad selection, rework and two-robot frame assembly, with paired rubber-contact and rigid hammers.

F2.intro_zh: 两台 Stretch 3 协作处理自由布料，完成抓持、折叠、分类放置和释放。当前录像只覆盖单条毛巾与被动翻板配置；衣堆整理和清单装箱仍未完成。
F2.intro_en: Two Stretch 3 robots grasp, fold, sort and release free cloth. The current recording covers one towel and a passive folding board; pile sorting and checklist packing remain incomplete.

F3.intro_zh: 穿戴者与辅助者协作整理衣料、送入袖口并操作扣具，目标是在撤去辅助支撑后保持完整穿戴。研究已暂停，外套完整穿戴和围裙扣合均未达到完整原目标，因此本族没有列入完成录像。
F3.intro_en: A wearer and helper coordinate fabric placement, sleeve insertion and fastening before releasing assistance. Research is paused: the full jacket and apron goals remain incomplete, so this family has no completed-task recording.

F4.intro_zh: 两台 G1 共同抓持、搬移并铺放布料，撤去夹具后仍须满足覆盖、对齐和平整要求。当前完成录像覆盖平面铺布；不规则台阶覆盖仍缺少完整边缘覆盖。
F4.intro_en: Two G1 robots carry and lay a sheet, then withdraw their clamps while preserving coverage, alignment and flatness. The completed recording covers a planar target; stepped-object covering still lacks complete edge coverage.

F6.intro_zh: 选择软管或线缆的路径，穿过导向框，完成插接、固定和释放。任务逐步加入工具选择、卷盘余量管理与真实卡阻恢复，并包含 G1 与 Stretch 3 的协作部署。
F6.intro_en: Route hoses or cables through guides, connect and secure them, then release the tools. Variants add tool choice, reel slack management, physical jam recovery and cooperative deployment by G1 and Stretch 3.

F7.intro_zh: 固定骨盆的 G1 利用弹性绑带、挂点和张紧器约束货物，退手后接受扰动测试。不同任务分别要求从零绑固、选择绑带与路径、诊断松弛，或在承托下解钩并重绑。
F7.intro_en: A fixed-pelvis G1 restrains cargo with elastic straps, anchors and tensioners, then withdraws for testing. Tasks cover initial fastening, strap and route choice, slack diagnosis, and supported unhooking and rebinding.

SK.title_en: Cooperative box pushing on hidden maps
SK.intro_zh: 两台 G1 依据各自第一视角和显式消息建立地图，通过推箱清路，最终同时驻留在各自目标区。箱子只能推，不能抓、拉或抬；六个配置改变瓶颈、信息分布、地图更新或双方能力。
SK.intro_en: Two G1 robots build maps from their own first-person observations and explicit messages, push crates aside and simultaneously hold their goal zones. Crates may only be pushed; six configurations vary bottlenecks, information, map updates and robot capabilities.

Hanoi.intro_zh: G1 借助工具将带孔圆盘越过杆顶并稳定放下，同时遵守汉诺塔顺序规则。末端、能力信息和盘数分别变化；部分配置只要求单次转移或完整符号规划后的前三次物理转移。
Hanoi.intro_en: G1 uses tools to lift annular disks over rods and release them while respecting Hanoi ordering rules. End effectors, capability disclosure and disk counts vary; some goals require only one transfer or the first three physical moves of a full symbolic plan.

MTC.intro_zh: 把杆、握柄、钩头和锁销组合成可承载的取物器，再从深箱取出目标并稳定存放工具。完成录像覆盖制作与部件选择两项；换杆重构的第三项尚未完成，未计入录像集合。
MTC.intro_en: Assemble rods, grips, a hook and a pin into a load-bearing retrieval tool, retrieve from a deep bin and store the tool stably. Completed recordings cover construction and component selection; the unfinished rod-exchange task is excluded.

SC.intro_zh: 单台 G1 在食材、厨具和炉具之间完成连续操作，处理带料工具、深锅、重锅或受限空间。五个配置以两份食材的熟化与安全收尾为目标，另一个配置要求判断不可完成并正确退出。
SC.intro_en: One G1 coordinates ingredients, utensils and stove controls across loaded-tool, deep-pot, heavy-pan and constrained-workspace tasks. Five configurations cook two portions and finish safely; one requires recognizing infeasibility and exiting correctly.

PC.intro_zh: 两台机器人通过接续操作、实物交接或手型分工完成烹饪，并协调订单与承载能力。五个烹饪配置保留明确的食材与交付范围，另设 G1 与 Stretch 3 的团队退出任务。
PC.intro_en: Two robots coordinate relay operations, physical handoffs or hand-specific roles while managing orders and load limits. Five cooking configurations retain explicit ingredient and delivery scopes; a G1–Stretch 3 task instead requires a correct team exit.

TT.intro_zh: 机械臂与人形机器人判断来球、把握击球时机，在连续对打中维持合法回合；死球必须放过。
TT.intro_en: Arms and humanoids judge incoming balls, time their strikes and sustain legal rallies; dead balls must be left untouched.

F1-01-L1-rigid.title_zh: 紧配合零件压入与敲合 · L1 · 刚体锤
F1-01-L1-rigid.title_en: Press-fit insertion and mallet seating · L1 · rigid hammer
F1-01-L1-rigid.description_zh: 用刚体金属锤把一个紧配合零件敲合到位。必须实际使用所给锤具轻敲，再控制压入力与停止时机，撤手后保持连接稳定。
F1-01-L1-rigid.description_en: Use the rigid metal hammer to seat one tight-fitting part. A real light tap is required; control insertion force and stop at the seated position before releasing the joint stably.
F1-01-L1-rigid.scope_zh: 单台固定骨盆 G1 使用仓库三指手与刚体金属锤头，配对锤具的几何和质量相同。
F1-01-L1-rigid.scope_en: One fixed-pelvis G1 with repository three-finger hands and a rigid metal hammer head; paired hammers have identical geometry and mass.
F1-01-L1-rigid.evidence_note_zh: 固定种子、固定骨盆 G1 与仓库三指手；采用原型接触参数。两种锤的几何与质量相同，仅锤头接触参数与颜色不同，不代表真实材料校准或正式末端对照。
F1-01-L1-rigid.evidence_note_en: Fixed seed and fixed-pelvis G1 with the repository three-finger hands and prototype contact parameters. The hammer pair shares geometry and mass; only head contact parameters and colour differ. This is not real-material calibration or a formal end-effector comparison.

F2-01-L1.description_zh: 两台 Stretch 3 协作抓持并折叠单条毛巾，再把它放到对应类别的位置。自由布料借助被动翻板成形，机器人需要协调抓点、释放时机和最终摆放。
F2-01-L1.description_en: Two Stretch 3 robots grasp and fold one towel, then place it in the matching category area. Coordinate grasp points, release timing and placement while shaping free cloth with a passive board.
F2-01-L1.scope_zh: 两台原生 Stretch 3 操作自由二维毛巾与无动力翻板，仅覆盖单条毛巾折叠。
F2-01-L1.scope_en: Two native Stretch 3 robots manipulate free 2D cloth and an unpowered board; scope covers one towel.
F2-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 原生双 Stretch 3、63 顶点自由二维布料与无执行器被动翻板；仅单次特权专家仿真参考，沿用旧精度口径。其他五项衣物配置没有完成录像。
F2-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Two native Stretch 3 robots, 63-vertex free 2D cloth and an unactuated passive board. This is one privileged expert simulation under the legacy precision profile; the other five laundry configurations have no completed recording.

F4-01-L1.description_zh: 两台 G1 用腕部夹具共同搬移布料，铺到中央矩形区域。撤去全部夹具后，布料仍须满足覆盖、边缘对齐、平整与稳定要求，连续保持一秒。
F4-01-L1.description_en: Two G1 robots use wrist clamps to carry a sheet onto the central rectangular target. After all clamps withdraw, sustain the required coverage, edge alignment, flatness and stability for one second.
F4-01-L1.scope_zh: 两台固定骨盆 G1 使用四个腕部平行夹具，目标为中央 0.58×0.38 米平面区域。
F4-01-L1.scope_en: Two fixed-pelvis G1 robots use four parallel wrist clamps to cover the central 0.58 × 0.38 m planar target.
F4-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 两台固定骨盆官方 G1、四个公开腕部平行夹具，目标区域为 0.58×0.38 米。完整物理目标已验证；严格数值复现未通过，空操作全轨迹审核尚未完成。
F4-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Two fixed-pelvis official G1 robots with four disclosed parallel wrist clamps; target area 0.58 × 0.38 m. The full physical goal is verified, but strict numerical reproduction failed and the full no-op audit remains unfinished.

F6-01-L1.description_zh: 把短软管穿过导向环，并将端头插入快接接口。完成保持与拉测后，用一个固定夹约束软管，再归还工具并让双手完全撤离。
F6-01-L1.description_en: Pass a short hose through the guide and insert its end into the coupling. Check retention with a pull, secure one clip, return the tool and withdraw both hands.
F6-01-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定软管与接触配置下完成单导向环、快接和单夹固定。
F6-01-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses the selected hose and contact settings for one guide, a coupling and one fixing clip.
F6-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3，仅覆盖归档的场景、工具、材料及接触配置；录像由封存状态重渲染，物理结论以对应核验为准。
F6-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3, limited to the archived scene, tools, material and contact settings. The video re-renders sealed states; physical conclusions rely on the corresponding verification.

F6-01-L2.description_zh: 根据可达长度选择软管和工具，规划穿过两个导向环的顺序。完成接口连接和双夹固定后，将工具独立放稳，避免布线受牵拉或依赖手部支撑。
F6-01-L2.description_en: Choose a hose and tools that can reach the target, then order the two-guide routing. Connect and fasten both clips before setting the tool down independently, without relying on hand support.
F6-01-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定材料与接触配置下完成双导向环布线和双夹固定。
F6-01-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 routes through two guides and secures two clips under the selected material and contact settings.
F6-01-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3，仅覆盖归档的场景、工具、材料及接触配置；录像由封存状态重渲染，物理结论以对应核验为准。
F6-01-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3, limited to the archived scene, tools, material and contact settings. The video re-renders sealed states; physical conclusions rely on the corresponding verification.

F6-01-L3.description_zh: 软管被错误固定点卡住，需要先解夹并退线至少四厘米。随后重新穿过两个正确闭框，完成插接拉测和双夹固定，最后把工具完整归还。
F6-01-L3.description_en: A wrongly placed clip jams the hose. Release it and retract at least four centimetres, then route through the two correct closed frames, connect, pull-test, secure both clips and return the tool.
F6-01-L3.scope_zh: 固定点与同侧托盘预先调整，G1 保留原生力矩限制，并须完成真实退线与工具归还。
F6-01-L3.scope_en: Anchors and the same-side tray are preadjusted; G1 retains native torque limits and must physically retract the hose and return its tool.
F6-01-L3.evidence_note_zh: 单台固定骨盆 G1/Dex3；固定点与同侧托盘预先调整，采用声明的有限接触律，保留原生限幅与完整工具归还要求。
F6-01-L3.evidence_note_en: One fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with preadjusted anchors and same-side tray. The declared finite contact law retains native actuator limits and full tool return.

F6-02-L1.description_zh: 从实体卷盘牵出线缆，让端头穿过导向环并接入快接接口。放线后通过真实接触操作制动器，使卷盘停稳，再释放双手并检查连接保持。
F6-02-L1.description_en: Pay cable out from a physical reel, pass its end through the guide and engage the coupling. Apply the contact-operated brake, stop the reel and release the hands while retaining the connection.
F6-02-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 操作实体卷盘与接触制动器，完成单环放线、插接和释放。
F6-02-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses a physical reel and contact brake for single-guide payout, coupling and release.
F6-02-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3，仅覆盖归档的场景、工具、材料及接触配置；录像由封存状态重渲染，物理结论以对应核验为准。

F6-02-L2.description_zh: 为线缆选择经过两个导向框的路径，并根据载荷与余量调整放线。需要协调牵引和接触制动，避免线缆过紧或余量失控，完成插接后停盘并释放。
F6-02-L2.description_en: Choose a route through two guides and regulate payout using cable load and slack. Coordinate pulling and contact braking to manage tension and excess cable, then connect, stop the reel and release.
F6-02-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定线缆配置下管理双导向路径的载荷、余量与卷盘制动。
F6-02-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 manages load, slack and reel braking along two guides with the selected cable configuration.
F6-02-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3，仅覆盖归档的场景、工具、材料及接触配置；录像由封存状态重渲染，物理结论以对应核验为准。
F6-02-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3, limited to the archived scene, tools, material and contact settings. The video re-renders sealed states; physical conclusions rely on the corresponding verification.

F6-02-L3.description_zh: 固定 G1 管理卷盘并按压解锁卡阻，Stretch 3 携带端头向前部署。线缆必须穿过两个闭合门架，完成接口拉测和制动后，两台机器人都要完全释放。
F6-02-L3.description_en: A fixed G1 manages and unlocks the jammed reel while Stretch 3 carries the cable end forward. Route through two closed frames, verify the coupling by pulling, brake the reel and release both robots.
F6-02-L3.scope_zh: 固定 G1 与轮驱 Stretch 3 协作，保留实体双卡爪、连接拉测和双机完全释放。
F6-02-L3.scope_en: A fixed G1 and wheeled Stretch 3 cooperate with physical dual jaws, coupling pull tests and complete release by both robots.
F6-02-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定 G1 与轮驱 Stretch 3；闭框为 1.4×1.7 米，仅覆盖声明的配合与余量范围，保留实体双卡爪、拉测及双机完全释放。
F6-02-L3.evidence_note_en: A fixed G1 and wheeled Stretch 3 with 1.4 × 1.7 m closed frames. Scope retains the declared coupling and slack range, physical dual jaws, pull test and complete release by both robots.

F7-01-L1.title_en: Elastic fastening of one cargo item
F7-01-L1.description_zh: 抓起一条弹性绑带，将它沿单件货物铺好并挂入可见锚点。操作张紧器建立约束，双手退出后接受托盘扰动测试，确认货物不再依赖机器人支撑。
F7-01-L1.description_en: Pick up one elastic strap, lay it over one cargo item and engage the visible anchors. Tension it, withdraw both hands and test the restraint under tray disturbance.
F7-01-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 约束单件货物，绑带采用离散弹性材料与数值接触模型。
F7-01-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 restrains one cargo item using a discrete elastic strap and numerical contact model.
F7-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3、单件货物及声明的离散弹性材料与数值接触；不代表硬件材料校准或其他身体配置。
F7-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3, one cargo item and the declared discrete elastic material and numerical contact model; no hardware calibration or other embodiments are covered.

F7-01-L2.description_zh: 面对两条独立绑带与两处扣件，根据锚点几何和材料柔顺性选择绑带及路径。完成抓取、固定和张紧后撤手，再用扰动检查所选约束是否有效。
F7-01-L2.description_en: Choose a strap and route from two independent straps and two fasteners using anchor geometry and compliance. Grasp, secure and tension the strap, withdraw and test the restraint.
F7-01-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定布局中选择两条独立绑带和两处扣件，材料采用离散弹性模型。
F7-01-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 selects between two independent straps and two fasteners in one layout, using a discrete elastic material model.
F7-01-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，采用声明的离散弹性材料与数值接触。固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，仅覆盖选定布局；其他随机布局与身体配置需另行验证。
F7-01-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with the declared discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 in the selected layout only; other randomized layouts and embodiments require separate verification.

F7-01-L3.title_en: Restraint of two independent cargo items
F7-01-L3.description_zh: 两件独立货物共用一条已经装好的低预载绑带，需要先通过运动诊断约束不足。随后调整张力，双手退出并重新测试，检查两件货物是否都被有效限制。
F7-01-L3.description_en: Two independent cargo items share an installed low-preload strap. Diagnose inadequate restraint through motion, correct its tension, withdraw both hands and retest both items.
F7-01-L3.scope_zh: 一条既有低预载绑带约束两件独立货物，仅调整张力，不包含从零抓取或安装绑带。
F7-01-L3.scope_en: One installed low-preload strap restrains two separate cargo items; scope covers tension adjustment, not initial pickup or installation.
F7-01-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，采用声明的离散弹性材料与数值接触。从既有绑带开始；不计从零抓取或安装信用，不覆盖双机、多条绑带及随机排列。
F7-01-L3.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with the declared discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. Starts with an installed strap. No credit is claimed for initial acquisition or installation, two-robot use, multiple straps or random arrangements.

F7-02-L1.description_zh: 识别已经安装的绑带为何明显松弛，并用实体张紧器恢复预载。恢复后必须撤去双手再复检，区分真正的货物约束与机器人暂时扶持造成的稳定。
F7-02-L1.description_en: Identify slack in an installed strap and restore preload with the physical tensioner. Withdraw both hands before retesting to distinguish actual restraint from temporary robot support.
F7-02-L1.scope_zh: 仅恢复既有松绑带的张力，不包含错误锚点重布或扭转纠正，材料采用离散弹性模型。
F7-02-L1.scope_en: Retension an installed slack strap under a discrete elastic model; wrong-anchor rerouting and twist correction are excluded.
F7-02-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，采用声明的离散弹性材料与数值接触。仅验证既有低预载绑带的张紧恢复，不提供错误锚点重布或有害扭转纠正的证据。
F7-02-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with the declared discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. Covers retensioning an installed low-preload strap, without evidence for rerouting wrong anchors or correcting harmful twists.

F7-02-L3.title_zh: 承托解钩与同挂点重绑
F7-02-L3.description_zh: 先承托货物并卸载绑带，再把 U 形挂钩从扣件中退出。随后在同一实体挂点重新绑固、恢复张力并撤手复检，整个过程都要维持货物支撑。
F7-02-L3.description_en: Support the cargo, unload the strap and withdraw the U-hook. Rebind at the same physical anchor, restore tension and release for retesting while preserving support throughout the operation.
F7-02-L3.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在承托下解钩并回到同一挂点重绑，不要求解钩是唯一修复方法。
F7-02-L3.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 unhooks under support and rebinds at the same anchor; unhooking need not be the only repair method.
F7-02-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，采用声明的离散弹性材料与数值接触。仅覆盖既有约束上的承托解钩与同挂点重绑，不声称解钩是修复初始松弛的唯一必要方法。
F7-02-L3.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with the declared discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. Covers supported unhooking and rebinding at the same anchor on an existing restraint; unhooking is not claimed to be the only necessary repair strategy.

SK-L1.description_zh: 两台 G1 在未知的四箱地图中探索，交换各自看到的通路信息。通过物理推箱清出路线，最后同时站稳在各自目标区；箱子只用于清路，不是需要交付的目标。
SK-L1.description_en: Two G1 robots explore an unknown four-crate map and exchange local route information. Physically push crates aside and simultaneously hold their goal zones; crates have no delivery targets.
SK-L1.scope_zh: 两台 G1 通过有限显式消息共享局部信息，完整地图与箱子真值隐藏，箱子只允许推。
SK-L1.scope_en: Two G1 robots exchange bounded explicit messages; the full map and crate ground truth are hidden, and crates may only be pushed.
SK-L1.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。
SK-L1.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit.

SK-L2-BTL.description_zh: 两台 G1 的路线经过共享瓶颈，需要协商谁先通行、谁先清除箱子。局部观察与显式消息共同更新地图，避免相互阻挡，最终同时驻留在各自目标区。
SK-L2-BTL.description_en: The robots share a bottleneck and must coordinate passage and crate clearing. Combine local observations with explicit messages to update the map, avoid blocking each other and hold both goals.
SK-L2-BTL.scope_zh: 共享瓶颈地图中，两台 G1 只能依靠局部观察和受限消息协调，箱子只允许推。
SK-L2-BTL.scope_en: On the shared-bottleneck map, two G1 robots coordinate from local observations and bounded messages; crates may only be pushed.
SK-L2-BTL.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。
SK-L2-BTL.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit.

SK-L2-INF.description_zh: 两台 G1 分别看到不同区域，需要把互补信息汇成可用的路线判断。机器人只能推箱改变通路，并通过显式通信协调探索与移动，最后同时到达各自目标。
SK-L2-INF.description_en: Each G1 sees different areas and must combine complementary information into usable route decisions. Push crates to change access and coordinate exploration and motion through explicit messages before reaching both goals.
SK-L2-INF.scope_zh: 两台 G1 的观察区域互补，完整地图隐藏，必须通过受限显式消息交换信息。
SK-L2-INF.scope_en: The two G1 robots observe complementary areas; the full map is hidden and information is exchanged through bounded explicit messages.
SK-L2-INF.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。
SK-L2-INF.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit.

SK-L2-UPD.description_zh: 箱子被推动后，原有地图中的可通行关系也会改变。两台 G1 需要发现并共享这些变化，更新路线而非沿用过期信息，最终同时在各自目标区站稳。
SK-L2-UPD.description_en: Pushing crates changes which map cells connect. Both G1 robots must detect and share these changes, revise stale routes and ultimately stand steadily in their own goal zones.
SK-L2-UPD.scope_zh: 推箱改变地图连通关系，两台 G1 需依据局部观察和显式消息更新地图。
SK-L2-UPD.scope_en: Crate pushing changes map connectivity; both G1 robots update their maps from local observations and explicit messages.
SK-L2-UPD.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。
SK-L2-UPD.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit.

SK-L3-A.title_zh: L3 · 能力反转 A（g1_a 手臂力矩降低）
SK-L3-A.title_en: L3 · Capability reversal A (reduced arm effort on g1_a)
SK-L3-A.description_zh: 保持四箱地图与目标不变，把机器人 A 的手臂力矩上限降到原来的四分之三。双方需结合自身能力分配推箱和通行任务，通过通信协调，最终同时抵达目标。
SK-L3-A.description_en: Keep the four-crate map and goals, but reduce robot A’s arm torque limit to three quarters of nominal. Allocate pushing and passage according to capability, coordinate by messages and reach both goals.
SK-L3-A.scope_zh: 地图与目标保持不变，机器人 A 的手臂力矩上限为原来的 0.75 倍，伙伴保持原值。
SK-L3-A.scope_en: The map and goals are unchanged; robot A’s arm torque limit is 0.75 of nominal while its partner remains nominal.
SK-L3-A.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。机器人 A 的手臂力矩上限为 0.75 倍，伙伴为 1.0 倍；该差异须由数值记录核对，不能仅凭录像识别。
SK-L3-A.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit. Robot A has a 0.75 arm-torque multiplier and its partner 1.0; this difference requires numerical evidence and is not visually established by the video.

SK-L3-B.title_en: L3 · Capability reversal B (reduced arm effort on g1_b)
SK-L3-B.description_zh: 沿用同一四箱地图，这次将机器人 B 的手臂力矩上限降到原来的四分之三。两台 G1 需要重新协调推箱分工与路线，使能力变化后仍能同时驻留在各自目标区。
SK-L3-B.description_en: Reuse the four-crate map with robot B’s arm torque limit reduced to three quarters of nominal. Recoordinate pushing roles and routes so both G1 robots can hold their goal zones.
SK-L3-B.scope_zh: 地图与目标保持不变，机器人 B 的手臂力矩上限为原来的 0.75 倍，伙伴保持原值。
SK-L3-B.scope_en: The map and goals are unchanged; robot B’s arm torque limit is 0.75 of nominal while its partner remains nominal.
SK-L3-B.evidence_note_zh: 两台 G1 仅用各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知和受限显式消息；地图与箱子真值隐藏。仅覆盖六个冻结通信配置，开发图结果不代表未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。机器人 B 的手臂力矩上限为 0.75 倍，伙伴为 1.0 倍；该差异须由数值记录核对，不能仅凭录像识别。
SK-L3-B.evidence_note_en: Two G1 robots use their own first-person RGB, proprioception and bounded explicit messages; map and crate ground truth are hidden. Scope covers six frozen communicating configurations, not unseen-topology generalization or a general communication benefit. Robot B has a 0.75 arm-torque multiplier and its partner 1.0; this difference requires numerical evidence and is not visually established by the video.

Hanoi-01.title_en: Dex3, three-disk full tower, capability disclosed
Hanoi-01.description_zh: G1 用 Dex3 手持工具，把三盘整塔从 A 杆搬到 C 杆。能力参数公开，必须按七步合法顺序逐次越杆转移，每次只能搬顶盘，最终撤具并保持整塔稳定。
Hanoi-01.description_en: Using Dex3 and a tool, move the complete three-disk tower from A to C. Capabilities are disclosed; make seven legal top-disk transfers over the rods, then withdraw the tool and leave a stable tower.
Hanoi-01.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3，能力公开，使用托叉完成三盘七步整塔转移。
Hanoi-01.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with disclosed capabilities uses a fork for the complete seven-move three-disk tower.
Hanoi-01.evidence_note_zh: Dex3，三盘七步整塔，能力公开。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-01.evidence_note_en: Dex3, seven-move three-disk tower, disclosed capabilities. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-02.title_zh: 平行夹爪·三盘整塔·能力公开
Hanoi-02.title_en: Parallel gripper, three-disk full tower, capability disclosed
Hanoi-02.description_zh: 把末端换成平行夹爪，在相同盘、杆和工具场景中搬完三盘整塔。能力信息公开，难点是把七步符号顺序落实为可靠抓持、越杆运动和完全释放。
Hanoi-02.description_en: Replace the end effector with a parallel gripper and move the same three-disk tower with the same rods and tools. With capabilities disclosed, turn seven symbolic moves into reliable grasping, clearance and full release.
Hanoi-02.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1 配平行夹爪，能力公开，使用托叉完成三盘七步整塔转移。
Hanoi-02.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1 with a parallel gripper and disclosed capabilities uses a fork for the complete seven-move three-disk tower.
Hanoi-02.evidence_note_zh: 平行夹爪，三盘七步整塔，能力公开；与 Dex3 配置使用相同物件。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-02.evidence_note_en: Parallel gripper, seven-move three-disk tower, disclosed capabilities and the same objects as the Dex3 configuration. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-03.title_en: Dex3, three-disk full tower, capability hidden
Hanoi-03.description_zh: 保留 Dex3 三盘整塔的物理场景，但不公开所选能力参数。任务要求在有限探测预算内判断工具使用方式，再按七步合法顺序完成搬运；录像提供特权参考路线。
Hanoi-03.description_en: Keep the Dex3 three-disk scene but hide selected capability parameters. The task calls for choosing tool use within a limited probing budget and executing seven legal moves; the video supplies a privileged reference.
Hanoi-03.scope_zh: 与 Dex3 能力公开配置的物理条件相同，只隐藏能力参数，目标仍为三盘七步整塔。
Hanoi-03.scope_en: The physics match the disclosed Dex3 configuration, with capability parameters hidden; the goal remains the seven-move three-disk tower.
Hanoi-03.evidence_note_zh: 与能力公开的 Dex3 配置物理条件相同；当前专家没有执行探测与预测评测。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-03.evidence_note_en: Physically identical to the disclosed Dex3 configuration; the current expert does not undergo probing or prediction evaluation. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-04.title_zh: 平行夹爪·三盘整塔·能力隐藏
Hanoi-04.title_en: Parallel gripper, three-disk full tower, capability hidden
Hanoi-04.description_zh: 平行夹爪需要借助工具完成三盘七步整塔，同时面对隐藏的能力信息。任务设计要求在有限探测后选择可行操作；当前录像展示同一物理条件下的特权专家转移。
Hanoi-04.description_en: A parallel gripper must complete the seven-move three-disk tower with capability information hidden. The task requires feasible choices after limited probing; the video shows privileged expert transfers in that physical setting.
Hanoi-04.scope_zh: 与平行夹爪能力公开配置的物理条件相同，只隐藏能力信息，目标仍为三盘七步整塔。
Hanoi-04.scope_en: The physics match the disclosed parallel-gripper configuration, with capabilities hidden; the goal remains the seven-move three-disk tower.
Hanoi-04.evidence_note_zh: 与能力公开的平行夹爪配置物理条件相同；隐藏能力下的自我建模尚未评测。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-04.evidence_note_en: Physically identical to the disclosed parallel-gripper configuration; self-modeling under hidden capabilities has not been evaluated. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-05.title_zh: Dex3·夹持边界·单次完整转移
Hanoi-05.title_en: Dex3, grip boundary, single complete transfer
Hanoi-05.description_zh: Dex3 的夹持能力降低且不公开，需要选择能稳住工具的握持方式。目标只是在取具后把最小盘从 A 杆完整搬到 C 杆，撤具并让所有圆盘独立稳定。
Hanoi-05.description_en: Dex3 grip capability is reduced and hidden, requiring a viable tool grasp. The goal is one complete smallest-disk transfer from A to C after tool pickup, followed by tool withdrawal and independent disk stability.
Hanoi-05.scope_zh: 夹持能力降为标称的四分之一，仅把最小盘从 A 移到 C，其余两盘留在 A。
Hanoi-05.scope_en: Grip capability is reduced to one quarter of nominal; transfer only the smallest disk from A to C and leave the others on A.
Hanoi-05.evidence_note_zh: 夹持能力为标称的 0.25 倍；仅单次转移，其余两盘留在 A，不包含整塔或反复换握维护。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-05.evidence_note_en: Grip capability is 0.25 of nominal. Only one transfer is required; the other two disks remain on A. This does not cover a full tower or repeated regrasp maintenance. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-06.title_zh: 平行夹爪·腕力矩边界·三盘整塔
Hanoi-06.title_en: Parallel gripper, wrist-torque boundary, three-disk full tower
Hanoi-06.description_zh: 平行夹爪的腕部力矩上限大幅降低，仍需完成三盘七步整塔。机器人要调整工具握持位置和运动方式，避免腕部饱和，同时保证每次越杆与释放都合法。
Hanoi-06.description_en: Complete the seven-move tower with a sharply reduced wrist-torque limit on the parallel gripper. Adjust the tool grasp and motion to avoid saturation while keeping every clearance and release legal.
Hanoi-06.scope_zh: 平行夹爪的腕部力矩上限降为标称的十六分之一且隐藏，仍须完成三盘七步整塔。
Hanoi-06.scope_en: The parallel gripper’s hidden wrist-torque limit is one sixteenth of nominal; the full seven-move three-disk tower is still required.
Hanoi-06.evidence_note_zh: 腕部力矩能力为标称的 0.0625 倍且隐藏；结论限于所测控制器，不证明其他策略不可行。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-06.evidence_note_en: Wrist-torque capability is hidden and reduced to 0.0625 of nominal; controller-specific comparisons do not prove that other strategies are infeasible. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-07.title_zh: Dex3·四盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
Hanoi-07.title_en: Dex3, four disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers
Hanoi-07.description_zh: 为四盘汉诺塔制定完整的十五步合法计划，再用 Dex3 实际完成前三次转移。物理终点是把上方两盘移到 C 杆，其余留在 A 杆，并在操作后稳定释放。
Hanoi-07.description_en: Plan all fifteen legal moves for four disks, then physically execute only the first three with Dex3. The physical endpoint places the top two disks on C, leaves the others on A and releases them stably.
Hanoi-07.scope_zh: 四盘需提交完整十五步符号计划，但仅物理执行前三次转移，不是整塔物理完成。
Hanoi-07.scope_en: Submit the full fifteen-move four-disk plan, but physically execute only the first three transfers, not the complete tower.
Hanoi-07.evidence_note_zh: 完整十五步仅作符号验证，物理执行范围为前三次转移；不宣称四盘整塔物理完成。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-07.evidence_note_en: All fifteen moves are checked symbolically, but only the first three transfers are physical; this is not a completed physical four-disk tower. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-08.title_zh: Dex3·五盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
Hanoi-08.title_en: Dex3, five disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers
Hanoi-08.description_zh: 面对五盘场景，先给出完整的三十一步合法计划，再实际执行前三次转移。Dex3 需要把上方两盘移到 B 杆，保留下方三盘的位置，并完成工具操作与稳定释放。
Hanoi-08.description_en: For five disks, provide all thirty-one legal moves and physically execute the first three. Dex3 moves the top two disks to B, leaves the lower three in place and completes stable tool-mediated release.
Hanoi-08.scope_zh: 五盘需提交完整三十一步符号计划，但仅物理执行前三次转移，不是整塔物理完成。
Hanoi-08.scope_en: Submit the full thirty-one-move five-disk plan, but physically execute only the first three transfers, not the complete tower.
Hanoi-08.evidence_note_zh: 完整三十一步仅作符号验证，物理执行范围为前三次转移；不宣称五盘整塔物理完成。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-08.evidence_note_en: All thirty-one moves are checked symbolically, with only the first three executed physically; this is not a completed physical five-disk tower. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-09.title_zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力公开
Hanoi-09.title_en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability disclosed
Hanoi-09.description_zh: G1 换用 Inspire 五指手，在能力公开的条件下选择并握持工具。取具后只把最小盘从 A 杆越杆移到 C 杆，随后撤具，其他两盘保持原位并共同稳定。
Hanoi-09.description_en: Use an Inspire five-finger hand with disclosed capabilities to acquire and grasp a tool. Transfer only the smallest disk from A to C over the rod, withdraw the tool and leave all disks stable.
Hanoi-09.scope_zh: 原生 Inspire 五指手、能力公开，仅完成最小盘 A 到 C 的一次转移，其余两盘留在原处。
Hanoi-09.scope_en: Native Inspire hand with disclosed capability; transfer only the smallest disk from A to C, leaving the other two in place.
Hanoi-09.evidence_note_zh: 原生 Inspire 五指手、标称能力公开；仅单次完整转移，不是三盘整塔。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-09.evidence_note_en: Native Inspire five-finger hand with disclosed nominal capability; one complete transfer, not the three-disk tower. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

Hanoi-10.title_zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力隐藏
Hanoi-10.title_en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability hidden
Hanoi-10.description_zh: 保留五指手单次转移的物理条件，仅隐藏能力信息。目标仍是取具后把最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆并撤具；有限探测属于任务要求，当前录像采用特权参考执行。
Hanoi-10.description_en: Keep the five-finger single-transfer physics but hide capability information. Acquire the tool, move the smallest disk from A to C and withdraw; limited probing is a task requirement, while this video uses a privileged reference.
Hanoi-10.scope_zh: 与五指手能力公开配置的物理条件相同，只隐藏能力信息，仅完成最小盘的一次转移。
Hanoi-10.scope_en: The physics match the disclosed five-finger configuration, with capabilities hidden; only one smallest-disk transfer is required.
Hanoi-10.evidence_note_zh: 与五指手能力公开配置相同的单次转移；专家未完成探测与预测评测。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像为读取真值的特权专家执行，不能视为从有限探测中学得身体模型的成绩。
Hanoi-10.evidence_note_en: The same single-transfer physics as the disclosed five-finger configuration; the expert does not undergo probing or prediction evaluation. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. This is privileged expert execution, not a score for learning a body model through limited probing.

MTC-L1.title_zh: 制作取物器并从深柜取物
MTC-L1.title_en: Construct a retrieval tool and retrieve from a deep bin
MTC-L1.description_zh: 从分散的杆、钩头和锁销开始，制作能够实际承载的取物器。装配后先松手验证连接，再重新握持并从深箱取出目标，最后把工具放到支撑面上稳定释放。
MTC-L1.description_en: Start with separate rods, a hook and a pin, and construct a load-bearing retrieval tool. Release to verify the assembly, regrasp and retrieve the target from a deep bin, then store and release the tool on a support.
MTC-L1.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1 与原生 Inspire 手，在宽开口深箱和受支撑存放条件下制作并使用工具。
MTC-L1.scope_en: Free-base G1 with native Inspire hands constructs and uses the tool with a wide-opening deep bin and supported storage.
MTC-L1.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1 与原生 Inspire 五指手；仅覆盖宽开口深箱和受支撑存放的声明配置。完整换杆与第二次取物尚未完成，不计入本记录或完成录像集合。
MTC-L1.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 with native Inspire hands, limited to the declared wide-opening deep-bin and supported-storage configuration. Complete rod exchange and second retrieval remain unfinished and are excluded from this record and the completed collection.

MTC-L2.title_zh: 选择杆长、握柄和工具头
MTC-L2.title_en: Select rod length, grip and tool head
MTC-L2.description_zh: 面对多种杆长、握柄和工具头，先选择适合深箱目标的部件组合。把选中的部件真实装配成取物器，完成带载取物、稳定交付和受支撑存放，不能只提交设计。
MTC-L2.description_en: Choose suitable rods, grips and a head from a multi-candidate inventory for the deep-bin target. Physically assemble the chosen tool, retrieve under load, deliver stably and store it on a support; a design alone is insufficient.
MTC-L2.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1 从多候选库存选择部件，仅覆盖组装取物，不包含未完成的换杆与第二次取物。
MTC-L2.scope_en: Free-base G1 selects components from multiple candidates for assembly and retrieval; unfinished rod exchange and second retrieval are excluded.
MTC-L2.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1 与原生 Inspire 五指手；仅覆盖宽开口深箱和受支撑存放的声明配置。完整换杆与第二次取物尚未完成，不计入本记录或完成录像集合。
MTC-L2.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 with native Inspire hands, limited to the declared wide-opening deep-bin and supported-storage configuration. Complete rod exchange and second retrieval remain unfinished and are excluded from this record and the completed collection.

SC-01.description_zh: 从装有两份生料的碗开始，把食材实际装入锅中并操作实体炉具开关。完成熟化后关火、释放厨具并保持稳定，连续衔接装料、加热与收尾。
SC-01.description_en: Start with a bowl containing two raw portions, physically load the pan and operate the stove switch. Cook the portions, turn off the heat, release the utensils and leave a stable final state.
SC-01.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1/Dex3 从两份生料开始，目标止于锅内熟化、关火和稳定释放。
SC-01.scope_en: Free-base G1/Dex3 starts with two raw portions and finishes with in-pan cooking, heat shutoff and stable release.
SC-01.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。
SC-01.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1, limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals.

SC-02.title_en: Loaded utensil withdrawal from a deep pot
SC-02.description_zh: 一份生料已经装在深锅内的抬高柄勺中，需要把带料工作头提过锅口。将食材倒入烹饪锅并承托归还勺子，再把两份食材加热熟化，最后关火。
SC-02.description_en: One raw portion is preloaded in a raised-handle spoon inside a deep pot. Lift its loaded head over the rim, pour into the cooking pan and return the spoon onto support before cooking both portions and turning off the heat.
SC-02.scope_zh: 深锅勺预装一份生料、冷锅内另有一份，仅覆盖带料取出与倒料，不包含动态舀取。
SC-02.scope_en: One portion starts loaded in the deep-pot spoon and another in the cold pan; scope covers loaded extraction and pouring, not dynamic scooping.
SC-02.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。带料勺从预装状态开始，不证明从散装食材中动态舀取。
SC-02.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1, limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. The spoon starts loaded; dynamic scooping from loose ingredients is not demonstrated.

SC-03.description_zh: 把已经装有一份生料的宽柄勺搬到烹饪锅上方，控制姿态完成倒料。随后将勺子放回实体工具架并释放，与锅中另一份食材一起完成熟化和关火。
SC-03.description_en: Carry a wide-handle spoon preloaded with one raw portion over the cooking pan and control the pour. Return and release the spoon on its rack, cook it together with the other portion and turn off the heat.
SC-03.scope_zh: 宽柄勺预装一份生料、冷锅内另有一份，须将两份熟化并把勺子放回工具架。
SC-03.scope_en: One portion starts loaded in the wide-handle spoon and another in the cold pan; cook both and return the spoon to its rack.
SC-03.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。宽柄勺从预装生料状态开始。
SC-03.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1, limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. The wide-handle spoon starts preloaded with raw ingredients.

SC-04.description_zh: 在持续受支撑的重锅中加热两份生料，关火冷却后用带料勺分出一份。机器人只提勺而不提重锅，将食材倒入受支撑接收盘，再归还并释放工具。
SC-04.description_en: Cook two raw portions in a continuously supported heavy pan. After turning off the heat and cooling, lift only the loaded spoon, transfer one portion into a supported plate and return and release the utensil.
SC-04.scope_zh: 2.5 千克重锅始终受支撑，仅提起带料勺分装一份，另一份留在锅内。
SC-04.scope_en: The 2.5 kg pan remains supported; lift only the loaded spoon to transfer one portion, leaving the other in the pan.
SC-04.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。重锅质量为 2.5 千克且始终受支撑；一份分装，另一份留在锅内。
SC-04.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1, limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. The 2.5 kg pan remains supported; one portion is transferred and the other remains in the pan.

SC-05.description_zh: 在有围挡的受限厨房中，把两份生料装入锅内并操作炉具。运动要避开原有障碍，完成加热、关火和稳定释放；展示中透明的围挡仍属于物理场景。
SC-05.description_en: Load two raw portions and operate the stove in a bounded kitchen. Avoid the original barriers while heating, turning off the stove and releasing stably; visually transparent barriers remain part of the physics.
SC-05.scope_zh: 两份生料在受限厨房内完成熟化，围挡只在展示中透明化，原始碰撞几何保留。
SC-05.scope_en: Cook two raw portions in the bounded kitchen; barriers are transparent only in presentation and retain their original collision geometry.
SC-05.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。围挡只在展示中透明化，原始碰撞几何保留。
SC-05.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1, limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. Barriers are transparent only in presentation; original collision geometry is retained.

SC-I01.description_zh: 面对已经独立核证的不可完成约束，先检查合法路线并依据证书作出退出判断。目标是让 G1 空手稳定结束任务，避免继续无效操作；这项不要求完成烹饪。
SC-I01.description_en: Check legal routes against independently certified infeasibility and decide to exit. The goal is a stable, empty-handed G1 termination without further ineffective manipulation; cooking is not required.
SC-I01.scope_zh: 依据已核证的不可完成条件，G1 空手稳定退出，正确退出不计为烹饪完成。
SC-I01.scope_en: Under certified infeasibility, G1 exits empty-handed and stable; a correct exit does not count as completed cooking.
SC-I01.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1/Dex3；成功目标为依据不可完成证书正确退出，不计为烹饪完成。
SC-I01.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1/Dex3; the success condition is a certificate-supported correct exit, not completed cooking.

PC-01.description_zh: 两台 G1 在同一厨房接续处理一批两份生料。供方先装料并实际退让，另一台再接手加热和关火，最后双方都脱手，让厨具与食材保持稳定。
PC-01.description_en: Two G1 robots relay one batch of two raw portions. The supplier loads and physically yields; the partner heats and turns off the stove, and both withdraw to leave utensils and ingredients stable.
PC-01.scope_zh: 两台自由基座 G1/Dex3 接续处理两份生料，供方退让后才由伙伴操作炉具。
PC-01.scope_en: Two free-base G1/Dex3 robots relay two raw portions; the supplier yields before its partner operates the stove.
PC-01.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。
PC-01.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots; limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals.

PC-02.title_en: Supported handoff of a loaded bowl
PC-02.description_zh: 在分区厨房中交接同一个带料碗，不能用替换物代替真实传递。供方先放下并退出，接收方再抓住碗、倒料、加热和关火，连续完成两份食材。
PC-02.description_en: Handoff the same loaded bowl across kitchen zones rather than substituting objects. The supplier places and withdraws; the receiver grasps it, pours, heats and turns off the stove to complete both portions.
PC-02.scope_zh: 两台 G1 在支撑面上交接同一个带料碗，完成两份食材，不能用替换物代替交接。
PC-02.scope_en: Two G1 robots hand off the same loaded bowl on a support and cook two portions; object substitution cannot replace the handoff.
PC-02.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。
PC-02.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots; limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals.

PC-03.description_zh: 两份订单在不同时刻释放，机器人需要安排共同备料和合批加热。两单都可执行后才使用同一个实物碗处理，并分别核对食材身份、熟度和截止时间。
PC-03.description_en: Two orders arrive at different times, requiring shared preparation and batched heating. Process them in the same physical bowl only after both are released, checking each order’s identity, doneness and deadline.
PC-03.scope_zh: 两单在 0 和 90 秒释放，截止时间分别为 180 和 200 秒，仅覆盖两单合批。
PC-03.scope_en: Orders release at 0 and 90 seconds, with deadlines of 180 and 200 seconds; scope covers batching these two orders.
PC-03.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。两单各一份食材，在 0 秒和 90 秒释放，截止时间分别为 180 秒与 200 秒；范围为两单合批。
PC-03.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots; limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. One portion per order, released at 0 and 90 seconds with deadlines of 180 and 200 seconds; scope is two-order batching.

PC-04.description_zh: 两台 G1 使用不同手型分工：Dex3 负责实际装料并退让，Inspire 五指手负责炉具操作。后者通过掌部接触控制开关，衔接加热和关火，最后共同退出。
PC-04.description_en: Two G1 robots divide work by hand type: Dex3 loads and yields, while the Inspire-hand robot operates the stove through palm contact. Coordinate heating, shutoff and final withdrawal.
PC-04.scope_zh: Dex3 负责装料，Inspire 手只承担掌部炉具操作，此处不包含五指手抓碗。
PC-04.scope_en: Dex3 loads the ingredients; the Inspire hand performs palm-based stove control, without a five-finger bowl grasp.
PC-04.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。Inspire 手仅承担所示掌部炉具操作，不推定其完成碗抓握。
PC-04.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots; limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. The Inspire hand performs the shown palm-based stove operation; bowl grasping is not established.

PC-05.description_zh: 供方释放带料载具后，接收方用右手承住它并离开支撑面。该固定负载需要真正由手部承受，再连续完成卸料、载具释放、烹饪与关火。
PC-05.description_en: After the supplier releases the loaded carrier, the receiver supports it in the right hand and lifts it clear of the support. Bear the fixed load physically, then unload, release the carrier, cook and turn off the stove.
PC-05.scope_zh: 100 克载具加两份各 20 克食材，总负载固定为 140 克，仅覆盖该承载条件。
PC-05.scope_en: A 100 g carrier and two 20 g portions total a fixed 140 g; arbitrary load capacity is not established.
PC-05.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；仅覆盖本项声明的两份食材与流程，不扩展为原始六份装盘或其他未声明交付。载具为 100 克，两份食材各 20 克，总负载 140 克；不扩展为任意负载能力。
PC-05.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots; limited to the declared two portions and workflow; it does not establish the original six-portion plated delivery or other unstated goals. A 100 g carrier and two 20 g portions total 140 g; this does not establish arbitrary load capacity.

PC-I01.description_zh: G1 与 Stretch 3 组成的团队面对已经核证的不可完成约束，需要共同作出退出决定。双方依据证书保持空手和稳定状态，不再尝试烹饪或危险的交接。
PC-I01.description_en: A G1–Stretch 3 team faces certified infeasibility and must decide to exit together. Follow the certificate, remain empty-handed and stable, and avoid further cooking or unsafe handoffs.
PC-I01.scope_zh: G1 与 Stretch 3 根据不可完成证书共同空手稳定退出，此项不要求完成烹饪。
PC-I01.scope_en: G1 and Stretch 3 follow an infeasibility certificate to exit together, empty-handed and stable; cooking is not required.
PC-I01.evidence_note_zh: 成功目标是团队正确退出，不计为烹饪完成；房间外墙、顶棚与隔墙只在展示中透明化。
PC-I01.evidence_note_en: Success means a correct team exit, not cooking. Outer walls, ceiling and partitions are made transparent only for presentation.

TT-D-A.title_zh: A3 死球判断与躯干避让
TT-D-A.title_en: A3 dead-ball judgment with body avoidance
TT-D-A.description_zh: A3 需要区分合法来球与擦网死球：合法球要回击，死球必须放过。沿用为 G1 设计的发球序列，在不焊接站立的条件下维持准备姿态，避免躯干误碰死球。
TT-D-A.description_en: A3 must return legal feeds and leave net-clip dead balls untouched. Using a launch sequence designed for G1, hold an unwelded standing posture and avoid dead-ball contact with the body.
TT-D-A.scope_zh: A3 不焊接站立，沿用 G1 发球序列判断合法球与死球，使用特权状态和无旋球。
TT-D-A.scope_en: A3 stands unwelded and judges legal and dead balls from the G1 launch sequence, using privileged state and spin-free balls.
TT-D-A.evidence_note_zh: 当前录像为 D2 原生任务参考；D1 仍有失败记录，有限搜索失败不构成物理不可完成证明。特权状态、无旋球的专家参考；录像重渲染已记录状态，不代表普通智能体的新闭环评测或留出种子泛化。
TT-D-A.evidence_note_en: The current video is the D2 native-task reference. D1 failures remain; failure of a finite search does not prove physical impossibility. Expert reference with privileged state and spin-free balls. The video re-renders recorded states; it is not a new closed-loop ordinary-agent evaluation or held-out-seed generalization result.

TT-D-G.title_zh: G1 死球判断与躯干避让
